automation.title: Automation
automation.empty.heading: Approve applications automatically
automation.empty.body: Set rules to approve or reject applications that match your conditions, and connect Shopify Flow.
automation.checkoutLock.message: This store sells to approved wholesale customers only. Log in or apply for an account.
automation.settings.heading: Automation settings
automation.settings.pausedHelp: New applications wait for you to review them. Your rules are kept.
automation.settings.dailyLimitHelp: {count, plural, one {# application was approved automatically today.} other {# applications were approved automatically today.}} When the limit is reached, the rest wait for you.
automation.rules.heading: Rules
automation.rules.body: Rejection rules run first, then approval rules. The first rule that matches decides. Rules only look at new applications.
automation.rules.noTiers: Create a tier first, so approval rules have somewhere to put buyers.
automation.condition.fieldHelp: Find the field ID in the form builder.
automation.action.sendWelcome: Send the buyer Shopify's B2B access email
automation.action.emailApplicant: Email the applicant that they were not approved
automation.action.reasonHelp: Shown in the email in the language you write it.
automation.error.summary: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before saving.} other {Fix # problems before saving.}}
automation.error.field_required: Enter both the field ID and the answer.
automation.error.dailyLimit: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
automation.recent.heading: Automatic decisions
automation.recent.none: No application has been decided automatically yet.
automation.recent.reversed.undone: Approval undone. The application is waiting for review again.
automation.recent.reversed.paused: Buyer paused. They now see retail prices.
automation.recent.reversed.reopened: Rejection reversed. The application is waiting for review again.
automation.recent.reverseFailed: Couldn't reverse this decision. Check the activity log and try again.
automation.reverse.heading: Reverse the decision for {company}?
automation.reverse.approvedBody: {company} will be paused: their company stays in Shopify, but they leave their tier and see retail prices. You can resume them from Buyers.
automation.reverse.rejectedBody: {company} goes back to Waiting for review. If a rejection email was sent, it can't be recalled.
automation.flow.heading: Shopify Flow
automation.flow.body: Use these Tradepass triggers and actions in Shopify Flow to build your own workflows, such as tagging buyers or sending a Slack message.
automation.flow.welcomeNote: Tradepass can already send Shopify's B2B access email when it approves a buyer, so no extra workflow is needed for that.
